The rising and setting horizons are the geographical ones imposed by the Cordon del Tontal (E) and the Andes (W)
Date: Date corresponding to the Night of Observation.
Start flats: Recommended time to start the acquisition of sky flats (you have at most 15 min. to acquire around 20 sky flats for each of the five filters).
Start: Recommended time for the start of the Night of Observation (Astronomical Twilight).
Tt.h: Total number of hours to observe (from *A to A*).
Dark: Total number of hours without Moon in the night (dark hours).
TD%: Percentage of dark hours in relation to the total amount of observation hours available.
from: Time when dark hours begin .
to: Time when dark hours end.
End: Recommended time for the end of the Night of Observation (Astronomical Dawn).
ILL%: Percent of the lunar disk illuminated by the Sun.
Note 1: All times are in UTC.
Note 2: The hours referred to the observation, correspond to the night of the date, and if it is an hour
less than "Start hours", it refers to the immediate morning, and not at dawn of the day to which it belongs that night.
